"Short answer: this pack is solid but a few things will bite you in the real world. Here’s a quick, no-nonsense audit + exact fixes you can drop in.
What’s good

💾 Idempotent workspace + logging ✔️

🧪 Minimal hello + heartbeat functions for smoke tests ✔️

🧹 Cleanup script won’t touch remote by accident ✔️

What needs fixing (ranked)

Env names — you explicitly told us don’t use SUPABASE_. The .env.example uses SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_*KEY.
▶︎ Fix: use APP_API_URL and APP_SERVICE_KEY everywhere. K"
